title: Raider Yabanin capability doctor report
description: Structured result of a Yabanin gateway capability probe. The doctor issues GET {base}/models and then GET {base}/yabanin/session-keys against the configured base URL, classifies each endpoint, records the first gateway decision header verbatim, and records the label header it sent. It never spends tokens, never mints a session key, and never falls back to a direct provider route.

base_url.description: The base URL the doctor probed, verbatim except trailing slashes trimmed.

labels.description: The label set the doctor attached to its requests (same canonical form as the labels contract).

http_status.description: Observed HTTP status, or null when the call failed below HTTP.

model_ids.description: Model ids from the catalog body when one was parseable; otherwise empty.

docs_version.description: docs_version reported by the catalog when present.

detail.description: Short explanation; must never contain credential values.
Short explanation; must never contain credential values. The probe never completes a mint.

decision.description: First gateway decision header observed (models, then session keys), stored verbatim as routing evidence. The doctor does not interpret or act on it.

observed_on.description: URL path of the response the header was observed on.

fallback_attempted.description: Structurally false: an auth or policy refusal is a terminal capability fact. There is no hidden direct fallback to any other provider route.
